blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.
blocks.zh: 健全的空间情报需要特工通过探索和互动来收集信息,然后用它来进行推理和行动. 现有基准没有充分区分正确结果和完成这些任务要求。 我们引入ROAM-Bench来评估这些在机器人运动和相撞限制下的能力. 独立检查使用模拟状态和相机记录来评估结果和任务要求,对几何,覆盖或放置进行更严格的检查. 它包括250项人工验证的任务,分为5个组和27个室内环境,涉及物体和房间的搜索、计数、几何判断、方向推理和搬迁。 人类评估人员在100个抽样任务中实现了84%的严格任务成功率,每个正确的结果都符合要求的检查。 在7个前沿愿景语言模式中,我们确定了两种互补的失败模式:正确结果与未满足的任务要求,以及尽管通过更严格的检查但结果不正确。 Oracle-input诊断显示,更完整的目标观测和校正反馈可以改善最终空间判断.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction. Counting mugs across a home, for example, requires searching multiple rooms, opening closed storage, and tracking objects across views to avoid double-counting (Fig. 1 ). The agent must also choose views that reveal occluded targets and decide when the search is complete. Yet an agent may report the correct count without observing every mug or checking every room. It may also make incorrect spatial judgments after collecting the required observations. Outcome correctness must therefore be evaluated alongside the task’s required observations and interactions.
blocks.zh: 健全的空间情报要求特工通过探索和互动来收集信息. 例如,在家中盘点杯子,需要搜索多间房间,打开封闭的存储器,并跟踪横跨视图的物体,以避免重复计算(图1)。 代理商还必须选择显示被占有的目标的视图,并决定搜索何时完成. 然而,一名特工可以报告正确的人数,而不观察每个杯子或检查每个房间。 它还可能在收集所需观测数据后作出不正确的空间判断。 因此,在评估结果正确性的同时,必须评估任务所需的观察和互动。

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks address different parts of this process. VSI-Bench [ 29 ] and MMSI-Bench [ 31 ] evaluate spatial question answering from preselected videos or images. EmbodiedQA [ 4 ] and OpenEQA [ 16 ] shift information gathering to the agent through question-driven navigation. EXPRESS-Bench [ 12 ] assesses answer grounding in the final observed image, while ESI-Bench [ 8 ] evaluates perception, locomotion, and manipulation for spatial QA. EmbodiedBench [ 30 ] and BEHAVIOR-Spatial [ 2 ] evaluate embodied tasks and spatial skills. Across these settings, final scores do not consistently distinguish correct outcomes from completed observation and interaction requirements.
blocks.zh: 现有基准涉及这一进程的不同部分。 VSI-Bench [29]和MMSI-Bench [31] 评估空间问题回答来自预选视频或图像. EmformQA [4]和OpenEQA [16] 通过由问题驱动的导航将收集的信息转移给代理人. EXPRESS-Bench [12] 评估答案在最终被观测到的图像中被打倒,而ESI-Bench [8] 则评价对空间QA的感知,运动和操纵. 健康奔驰[30]和BEHAVIOR-空间[2]评价包含的任务和空间技能. 在这些设置中,最终的分数无法一致地将正确结果与已完成的观察和互动要求区分开来.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce ROAM-Bench, which evaluates task outcomes together with the observations and interactions required to reach them. The benchmark comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups: grounding, aggregation, geometry, reference-frame integration, and goal-directed spatial action. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and separately verify required observations, search coverage, ordered interactions, geometry, and object placement. This verification helps distinguish missing observations from mistakes made after collecting them for deeper failure analysis. Task success requires these conditions together with a correct outcome, measuring how exploration, spatial judgment, and action work together.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了ROAM-Bench,它评估任务结果以及达到这些结果所需的观察和互动。 基准包括250项人工验证的任务,分为5个类别:地面、汇总、几何、参照框架整合和瞄准空间行动。 独立检查使用模拟状态和分集记录来评估结果并分别核实所需的观测,搜索覆盖,命令交互,几何,以及物体放置. 这一核查有助于区分缺失的观察和收集后的错误,以便进行更深入的失败分析。 任务的成功需要这些条件以及正确的结果,衡量探索、空间判断和行动如何合作。

blocks.en: Our platform, built on Isaac Sim [ 17 ] , provides 27 furnished indoor environments generated with SceneSmith [ 19 ] and manually corrected for benchmark use. A vision-language model (VLM) chooses predefined navigation and interaction skills, including moving, observing, opening, picking, and placing. The simulator executes these atomic skills under declared motion and interaction constraints. After each skill, the agent receives a new view and action feedback before choosing its next step. The feedback reports collisions and object-handling outcomes, which the agent can use to adjust its plan.
blocks.zh: 我们的平台建于Isaac Sim [17] 之上,提供27个与SceneSmith [19] 生成的室内家具环境,并手动校正用于基准使用. 一个视觉语言模型(VLM)选择了预先定义的导航和交互技能,包括移动,观察,打开,取出,和放置. 模拟器在宣布的运动和相互作用的限制下执行这些原子技术. 在每个技能之后,代理在选择下一步之前会收到新的视图和动作反馈. 反馈报告碰撞和物体处理结果,物剂可以用来调整其计划.

blocks.en: Our contributions are (1) A comprehensive benchmark and evaluation protocol for embodied spatial intelligence , connecting exploration, spatial judgment, and goal-directed action. (2) An executable exploration platform with atomic actions, leveraging simulation oracles to verify task outcomes and task-required evidence. (3) Human and frontier VLM evaluations with supporting diagnostics covering information acquisition, precision, relocation failures, input sensitivity, and costs that include failures.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(1) 综合的空间情报基准和评价协议,将探索、空间判断和目标行动联系起来。 (2)具有原子作用的可执行探索平台,利用模拟甲骨文来验证任务结果和任务需要的证据. (3)人和边疆VLM评价,辅以诊断,涵盖信息获取,精度,迁移故障,输入灵敏度和包括故障在内的成本.

blocks.en: Work in this area studies spatial understanding from images and video. VSI-Bench [ 29 ] evaluates video-based inference, and MindCube [ 26 ] tests limited-view spatial modeling. MMSI-Bench [ 31 ] evaluates multi-image reasoning with reference-assisted diagnosis. SpatialBench [ 28 ] and SITE [ 27 ] examine capability and modality coverage. BLINK [ 6 ] tests depth and correspondence. Beyond interpreting visual observations, embodied evaluations test goal completion through navigation and interaction. EmbodiedBench [ 30 ] evaluates vision-driven tasks, while Embodied Agent Arena [ 9 ] checks outcomes and execution conditions. ALFRED [ 25 ] and BEHAVIOR-1K [ 15 ] evaluate household activities. Room-to-Room [ 1 ] tests instruction-following navigation. Beyond Spatial Benchmarks [ 10 ] examines spatial-reasoning transfer. Habitat [ 23 ] and AI2-THOR [ 14 ] provide simulation. EgoPlan-Bench2 [ 20 ] evaluates planning. BEHAVIOR-Spatial [ 2 ] connects QA, grounding, and robot action.
blocks.zh: 这一领域的工作从图像和录像中研究空间理解。 VSI-Bench [29]评价以视频为基础的推论,而MindCube [26] 测试有限视空间模型. MMSI-Bench [31]评价多图像推理与参考辅助诊断. 空间奔驰[28]和SITE[27]审查能力和覆盖方式。 BLINK [6]测试深度与对应. 除了解释视觉观察之外,还包括通过导航和互动测试目标完成情况的评价。 健美奔驰 [30] 评估由视觉驱动的任务,而健美特工 Arena [9] 检查结果和执行条件. ALFRED [25]和BEHAVIOR-1K [15] 评估家庭活动. 房间对房间 [1] 测试指令跟随导航. 空间基准以外[10]审查空间理由转让。 栖息地[23]和AI2-THOR[14]提供模拟. EgoPlan-Bench2 [20] 评价规划. BEHAVIOR-空间 [2] 连接QA,地面,和机器人动作.

blocks.en: This line of work links visual and language understanding to robot behavior. SayCan [ 11 ] grounds plans in skill affordances. PaLM-E [ 5 ] integrates observations and language. RT-2 [ 33 ] transfers vision-language knowledge to control. OpenVLA [ 13 ] and Octo [ 18 ] develop generalist policies. RoboVQA [ 24 ] evaluates long-horizon reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这一行的工作将视觉和语言理解与机器人行为联系起来. SayCan[11]在技能承受能力方面计划。 PaLM-E [5] 融合了观测和语言. RT-2 [33]将视觉语言知识转移至控制. OpenVLA [13]和Octo [18] 制定通论政策. RoboVQA [24]评价长相推理.

blocks.en: These tasks require agents to seek observations before answering. EmbodiedQA [ 4 ] and Multi-Target EQA [ 32 ] evaluate question-conditioned navigation. IQA [ 7 ] tests information-revealing interactions. OpenEQA [ 16 ] evaluates memory and exploration. Explore until Confident [ 21 ] studies stopping, while EfficientEQA [ 3 ] combines exploration with retrieval. E3VS-Bench [ 22 ] evaluates viewpoint-dependent search. EXPRESS-Bench [ 12 ] uses a VLM to score answer correctness and grounding in the final first-person image. ESI-Bench [ 8 ] tests perception, locomotion, and manipulation across 10 categories and compares active, passive, and oracle inputs.
blocks.zh: 这些任务要求特工在答复前先征求意见. EmbodyQA [4]和多目标 EQA [32] 评估有问题条件的导航. IQA [7]测试信息-启示互动. OpenEQA [16]评价内存和探索. 探索直到自信[21]研究停止,而高效EQA[3]结合了探索和检索. E3VS-Bench [22] 评测视角依赖搜索. EXPRESS-Bench [12] 使用VLM对答正确性进行分分并打入最终第一人称图像. ESI-Bench [8] 测试认知,运动,和操控共分10个类别,并比较主动,被动,和甲骨文输入.

blocks.en: These directions address complementary parts of embodied tasks: understanding space, choosing actions, and gathering observations. To evaluate how these capabilities work together under robot motion and collision constraints, ROAM-Bench independently checks outcomes and task-required observations and interactions across complete episodes. Additional checks examine geometry and post-placement support. This connects final performance to the exploration and interaction process and supports detailed analysis of failures in observation acquisition, spatial judgment, and action (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 这些方向涉及包含的任务的补充部分:理解空间、选择行动和收集观测。 为了评价这些能力在机器人运动和相撞限制下如何共同工作,ROAM-Bench独立地检查结果和任务要求的观察和整个过程中的相互作用。 附加检查检查几何和位置后支持. 这把最终性能与探索和互动过程联系起来,并支持对观测获取、空间判断和行动方面的失败进行详细分析(表1)。

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 3 基准设计

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Taxonomy and Interaction
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务分类和相互作用

blocks.en: To evaluate embodied active spatial intelligence, we design tasks that combine exploration, spatial reasoning, and interaction in different ways. For example, counting may require searching several rooms, gap measurement requires observing both edges, and relocation requires finding and moving the correct object. On our platform based on Isaac Sim [ 17 ] , the agent gathers observations and interacts with objects until it completes the task. We then check the final result and whether the task is carried out as required.
blocks.zh: 为了评价包含的活性空间智能,我们设计了以不同方式将探索、空间推理和相互作用结合起来的任务。 例如,计数可能需要搜索几个房间,空隙测量需要观察两个边缘,而迁移则需要查找并移动正确的对象. 在我们基于Isaac Sim [17] 的平台上,代理人收集观测结果并和物体相互作用,直到完成任务. 然后,我们检查最终结果以及任务是否按要求执行。

blocks.en: We group the 11 task types by their main answer or action (Fig. 2 ). G1, semantic-spatial grounding , identifies objects and rooms. G2, spatial aggregation , counts objects or rooms across views. G3, metric and comparative geometry , estimates distances, areas, and gaps or compares proximity. G4, reference-frame integration , judges directions from reference objects or the agent’s final position and heading. G5, goal-directed spatial action , finds and transfers the specified object to its destination.
blocks.zh: 我们按主要答案或行动划分这11个任务类别(图2)。 G1,语义-空间地平线,识别物体和房间. G2, 空间聚合, 数物体或房间, G3, 度量和比较几何, 估计相距, 面积, 相差或相比相近 。 G4,参考框架整合,判断参考对象的指示或代理人的最终位置和标题. G5,目标定向空间动作,找到指定对象并将其转移到目的地.

blocks.en: Tasks describe targets through reference images of objects or surfaces, category names, and room names. To find a named room, the agent must infer its function from the layout and furnishings. The instructions also guide exploration and spatial judgment: counting questions specify where to search, while direction questions specify the position and orientation from which directions are judged. The agent therefore needs to interpret the task before deciding where to look and what to observe.
blocks.zh: 任务通过对象或表面的参考图像,类名,和房间名来描述目标. 要找到一个有名的房间,代理人必须从布局和家具中推断出它的功能. 指令还指导了探索和空间判断:计数问题指定了搜索地点,而取向问题则指定了判断方向的位置和方向. 因此,代理人需要先对任务进行解释,然后再决定在哪里看和观察。

blocks.en: All groups allow navigation— move, strafe, turn, look —and object interaction— open, close, pick, place . G1, G2, and G5 also permit navigation to an object or ground point selected in the latest image, emphasizing search and object handling. G3 and G4 require movement distances and directions to be specified, testing metric and reference-frame reasoning. To specify target objects and navigation locations without ambiguity, we use pixel selection in the latest camera image for object interaction and image-point navigation.
blocks.zh: 所有组都允许导航——移动,strafe,转身,外观——和对象交互——打开,关闭,取出,放置. G1,G2,和G5也允许导航到最新图像所选择的对象或地点,强调搜索和对象处理. G3和G4要求指定移动距离和方向,测试度量衡和参考框架推理. 为了毫不含糊地指定目标对象和导航位置,我们在最新的相机图像中使用像素选择来进行对象交互和图像点导航.

blocks.en: 3.3 Task Generation and Validation
blocks.zh: 3.3 任务的产生和验证

blocks.en: We generate questions, reference answers, and goal conditions from the objects, room assignments, and geometry recorded in each scene. We check task feasibility through an oracle trajectory generated using simulator state and the available skills. We then manually inspect the scene to verify the instructions, answers or goals, and observation and interaction checks described below. This includes checking which objects and rooms must be counted, how directions are defined, and which object must be picked and subsequently placed at which destination.
blocks.zh: 我们从每个场景中记录的物体、房间分配和几何来生成问题、参考答案和目标条件。 我们通过一个利用模拟状态和现有技能生成的甲骨文轨迹来检查任务可行性. 然后我们手动检查现场,以核实以下说明的指示、答案或目标以及观察和互动检查。 这包括检查哪些物体和房间必须计算,如何定义方向,以及哪些物体必须取出并随后放置在哪个目的地.

blocks.en: 3.4 Outcome and Evidence Verification
blocks.zh: 3.4 结果和证据核查

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Agent Interaction
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 代理人相互作用

blocks.en: At each round, the agent receives the task, reference images, latest camera image, available sensor readings, and feedback from its actions. Earlier observations and a visualization of the traveled path help it relate the current view to previous locations. Before executing a skill or submitting an answer or completion report, it can retrieve relevant earlier images using their text summaries. Retrieved images are added to the current round. Executing a skill produces the next observation and action feedback. Actions that select image points refer to the latest camera image. Once the agent finishes, the evaluator checks the final result and whether the task is carried out as required (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 每轮,代理接收任务,参考图像,最新相机图像,可用的传感器读取,以及其动作的反馈. 早先的观察和对行走路径的可视化有助于将目前的观点与以前的地点联系起来。 在执行技能或提交答案或完成报告之前,它可以使用相关的早期图像的文本摘要来检索. 已获取的图像被添加到当前回合中 。 执行技能可产生下一次观察和行动反馈。 选择图像点的动作指的是最新的相机图像. 代理完成后,评估人员会检查最终结果以及任务是否按要求完成(图3.).

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Outcome and Evidence Criteria
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 结果和证据标准

blocks.en: A correct answer alone does not show that the agent completes the task’s required exploration and interactions. Conversely, an agent can complete the required observations yet answer incorrectly. We therefore check the result and task execution separately.
blocks.zh: 仅靠正确的答案并不能表明代理人完成了任务所需的探索和互动. 相反,代理人可以完成所要求的观察,但回答不正确。 因此,我们检查结果并分别执行任务。

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Task-Specific Evidence Requirements
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 特定任务的证据要求

blocks.en: The checks follow each task’s requirements. For example, counting checks which objects and rooms the agent observes, while relocation checks which object it picks and where it places it.
blocks.zh: 检查符合每项任务的要求。 例如,检查代理人观察到的物体和房间,同时检查其选择的物体和位置。

blocks.en: N checks whether the required targets appear in the 768 × 432 768\times 432 camera images. Counting also checks the specified object instances and search scope. A room counts as observed when the agent enters it or obtains an object view that passes the visibility check in that room. S can additionally require room visits and clear target views. Within a room, views from similar camera positions and orientations count once toward viewpoint coverage.
blocks.zh: N检查所需目标是否出现在768×432 768\times 432相机影像中. 计数还检查指定的对象实例和搜索范围 。 当代理进入或获得通过该房间的能见度检查的物体视图时,一个房间算得上是所观察到的. S还可以要求房间访问和明确的目标观点。 在一间房间里,从类似相机位置和取向的角度看问题,就一次地看问题。

blocks.en: For nearer-object questions, A checks the selected answer and N checks whether all referenced objects are observed. S additionally checks that depth-based distances identify the correct nearest candidate and distinguish it from the next closest after accounting for measurement uncertainty. Distance, direction, and gap-width tasks similarly compare geometry reconstructed from the recorded views with the task reference. For room area, N requires entering the target room, while S requires valid depth views from several directions.
blocks.zh: 对于更接近对象的问题,A检查所选答案和N检查所有被引用对象是否被观察到. 此外,还要检查深度距离是否确定最接近的人选,并在计算测量不确定性后将其与最近的人选区分开来。 相距、方向和相距相距任务同样将从记录的视图中重建的几何与任务参考进行比较。 对于房间面积,N需要进入目标房间,而S则需要从几个方向获得有效的深度视图.

blocks.en: For relocation, N checks that the agent picks the specified object before placing that same object at the destination. For hidden targets, the checks also require opening the container before revealing the object. S additionally checks that the released object rests on the specified destination.
blocks.zh: 为了迁移,N检查代理在将同一对象放置在目的地之前是否选择指定的对象。 对于隐藏目标,检查还需要打开容器后才能披露物体。 另外还要检查是否已释放的对象是否位于指定的目的地.

blocks.en: In path integration, the agent searches for two landmarks and reports where its starting position lies relative to its final position and heading. The provided start and final poses supply the information needed to judge this direction. Accordingly, A \mathrm{A} checks the direction answer, while N \mathrm{N} checks whether the agent observes both landmarks, regardless of order. S \mathrm{S} additionally checks room and viewpoint coverage. A correct answer with N = 0 \mathrm{N}=0 therefore means that the required landmark exploration is unfinished.
blocks.zh: 在路径集成中,代理搜索两个地标并报告其起步位置与其最终位置和取向相对. 所提供的开始和最后信息提供了判断这一方向所需的信息。 因此,A\mathrm{A}检查方向答案,而N\mathrm{N}检查代理人是否遵守了两个地标,不管顺序如何. S\ mathrm{S} 额外检查房间和视野覆盖 。 用 N = 0\ mathrm{ N}=0 正确回答,因此意味着所需的地标探索尚未完成。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 实验评价.

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Models and Interaction
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 模式和相互作用

blocks.en: We evaluate the seven VLMs in Table 2 on the same 250 tasks across 27 environments. Each episode starts from its defined scene state and camera pose. Agents use the public observation and skill interfaces until answering, signaling completion, or exhausting their room-scaled action budgets. High-level action decisions are charged.
blocks.zh: 我们评价表2中的七项自愿活动,评估27个环境的250项任务。 每集从它定义的场景状态和相机姿势开始. 特工们使用公共观察和技能接口,直到回答,信号完成,或者耗尽了房间规模的行动预算. 要求作出高级别行动决定。

blocks.en: Human evaluators complete a stratified sample of 100 tasks, one person per task, through the public observation and action interface. In a separate audit, human evaluators check N/S conditions for 200 episodes. Agreement with automatic checks is 97.4% for N (196 ratable cases) and 93.3% for S (194 ratable cases).

blocks.en: GPT-6-astra achieves the highest strict task success, but still fails on nearly one-third of the tasks. The remaining models achieve strict task success on fewer than half of the tasks. Moreover, 29 tasks receive no correct answer from any model. Together, these results indicate persistent difficulty in connecting exploration, spatial judgment, and action.
blocks.zh: GPT-6-astra取得了最严格的任务成功,但仍有将近三分之一的任务失败. 其余模式在不到一半的任务上取得了严格的任务成功。 此外,29项任务没有得到任何模式的正确答复。 这些结果表明,在将探索、空间判断和行动联系起来方面始终存在困难。

blocks.en: Correct outcomes do not always mean that required observations and interactions are complete. The 106 path-integration gaps concern unmet landmark exploration. Across the other task types, 100/1,540 episodes have correct outcomes but unmet task requirements. All seven models exhibit this gap (6–18 cases each).
blocks.zh: 正确的结果并不总是意味着所需要的观察和互动是完整的。 106个道路一体化差距涉及未实现的里程碑式探索。 在整个其他任务类型中,100/1 540集有正确的结果,但没有达到任务要求。 所有七个模型都显示出这一差距(每个模型6至18个案例)。

blocks.en: Conversely, incorrect outcomes also occur after stronger corroboration checks (S) pass. Every VLM has a higher error rate in these episodes than human evaluators. In the 100-task human sample, all correct outcomes meet required coverage, and errors after S passes are rare. Together, these findings motivate linking target search and coverage tracking with reliable instance-level spatial judgment.
blocks.zh: 反之,在加强确证检查(S)之后也会出现不正确的结果。 每一个VLM在这些剧集中的出错率都高于人类评价员. 在100任务人类样本中,所有正确结果都符合规定的覆盖范围,而S出道后出错是罕见的. 这些调查结果共同促使将目标搜索和覆盖跟踪与可靠的实例层面空间判断联系起来。

blocks.en: Relocation is the weakest group for six of the seven models, while locating objects and identifying their rooms is generally easier. GPT-6.1-sol performs better on geometry than on grounding, whereas both Claude models show the reverse pattern. These profiles distinguish scale estimation, cross-view instance tracking, and intended-object transfer.
blocks.zh: 搬迁是7个模型中6个模型中最弱的一组,而定位物体并识别其房间一般比较容易. GPT-6.1-溶液在几何学上的表现优于地平面,而两者均 Claude模型显示了相反的模式. 这些剖面图区分了尺度估计,交叉视图实例跟踪,以及预定对象的转移.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 分析和讨论

blocks.en: Errors after observation checks pass reveal spatial-judgment difficulties, while human evaluators identify incomplete target observation. Recorded answers, actions, and input comparisons locate frontier VLM bottlenecks.
blocks.zh: 观测检查通过后的错误揭示出空间判断困难,而人类评估人员则识别出不完整的目标观测. 被录制的答案,动作,和输入比较 定位前沿 VLM 瓶颈.

blocks.en: 5.1 Spatial Judgment across Task Groups
blocks.zh: 5.1 各工作组的空间判断

blocks.en: We examine G1–G4 using errors after observation checks and numerical precision.
blocks.zh: 我们使用观察检查和数字精确后的错误来检查G1-G4。

blocks.en: Room options provide names, requiring models to infer room functions from layouts and furnishings. For GPT-6.1-sol and GPT-6-astra, room-function inference remains harder than local object recognition after N passes. This contrast highlights the need to connect visible objects with a room’s overall layout and function.
blocks.zh: 房间选项提供名称,需要模型从布局和家具中推断出房间功能. 对于GPT-6.1-sol和GPT-6-astra,室功能推论仍然比N通后局部物体识别更难. 这种对比突出了将可见物体与一个房间的总体布局和功能相接的必要性。

blocks.en: Counting errors persist for these models after both N and S pass. Completing observation checks does not ensure a consistent global count, highlighting cross-view instance identity and quantity integration as demands of spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这些模型在N和S通后仍然存在计数错误. 完成观测检查不能确保全球计数的一致性,强调跨视实例身份和数量整合是空间推理的要求.

blocks.en: Gap width has the most models with median error above tolerance (Fig. 5 ). Halving tolerances preserves the overall A/T ranking (Appendix 11.3 ). Continuous errors reveal precision differences that binary scores can obscure.
blocks.zh: 相隔宽度的模型中,偏差最大,高于容忍度(图5). 将相容性减半,保持了A/T的整体排名(附录11.3). 连续出错揭示出二进制分数可能模糊的精度差异.

blocks.zh: 图5:空间数字精确度。 (a-c) 7个VLM:中位绝对误差除以可解答的相容性. 数值大于允许的错误。 (d) 人类评价员的估计:在每个容忍尺度内的百分比(每类40个判断)。

blocks.en: Across all seven models, relative-direction errors exceed path-integration errors after N passes. These questions require constructing a frame from two reference objects to locate a third. Explicit representations of the frame’s origin and forward axis may help these judgments.
blocks.zh: 在所有7个模型中,相对方向错误超过N通后路径集成错误. 这些问题需要从两个参考对象中构建一个框架来定位第三个. 明确表述框架的起源和前向轴可能有助于这些判断。

blocks.en: 5.2 Object Relocation
blocks.zh: 5.2 对象迁移

blocks.en: All seven models lose the most episodes before picking the correct object on the same relocation tasks. Later failures involve transferring that same object and verifying destination support (see the relocation milestones in Table S11 ). This shared pattern identifies target selection and correct pickup as the main relocation bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 所有7个模型在在同一迁移任务上选择正确对象之前都会丢失最多的几集. 后来的失败涉及转移同一对象并核实目的地支持(见表S11中的迁移里程碑)。 这种共同模式确定目标选择和正确的取回是主要搬迁瓶颈。

blocks.en: Wrong-object pickup dominates early failures in every model. Feedback can also explain why a pick fails: the selected image point is on a floor or wall, or the arm cannot reach the object. Some models select another point or move the base but repeat the same error. These failures highlight the need to verify target identity and use feedback to correct subsequent actions.
blocks.zh: 错误的对象皮克在每一个模型中都占据了早期的失败. 反馈也可以解释一个取出失败的原因:选定的图像点位于地上或墙上,或者臂无法到达对象. 一些模型选择另一个点或移动基点,但重复同样的错误. 这些失败凸显出需要验证目标身份,并使用反馈来纠正后续行动.

blocks.en: 5.3 Oracle Input Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 5.3 甲骨文输入诊断

blocks.en: We select 139 active-exploration tasks from G1–G4 in 26 scenes with recoverable final-answer inputs and target views. Four ground-truth (GT) settings test final judgments. GT retrieval adds all task-relevant object frames from each model’s own prior trajectory before answering. GT view supplementation adds target views from other trajectories of the same task, including unseen targets. Both retain the original exploration context. GT trajectory RGB replaces views and context with generated GT trajectory observations, retaining the question and public references. GT trajectory + sensors adds radial depth, camera pose, and calibration jointly to the same RGB views and order. The baseline reuses original outcomes. Each GT setting produces one new answer without further actions, with construction-specific view counts and coverage. All seven models show similar trends across settings, so Table 3 pools 973 evaluations per setting.
blocks.zh: 我们在26个场景中从G1-G4中选择了139个主动探索任务,并附有可回收的最终答案和目标视图. 4个地真相设置测试最终判决。 GT 检索在回答前会从每个模型自己的先前轨迹中添加所有与任务相关的对象框架 。 GT视图补充增加了来自同一任务的其他轨道的目标视图,包括未见的目标. 两者都保留了最初的勘探背景. GT轨迹 RGB以生成的GT轨迹观测取代了视图和上下文,保留了问题和公众参考. GT轨迹+传感器为相同的RGB视图和顺序增加了射线深度,相机姿势,并共同校正. 基准重用原始结果。 每个GT设置生成一个新的答案,不采取进一步行动,并有建筑特定视角的计数和覆盖. 所有七个模型都显示不同环境的类似趋势,因此,表3汇总了每个环境的评价973。

blocks.en: GT view supplementation improves final judgments more than GT retrieval in every model (Table 3 ). Earlier images cannot provide observations of targets missed during exploration. This pattern suggests that VLMs would benefit from recognizing which task-relevant targets remain unseen and seeking views that fill these gaps.
blocks.zh: GT视图补充改进了每个模型中最终判断多于GT检索(表3. 早期的图像无法提供在勘探过程中被遗漏目标的观察. 这种模式表明,从认识到哪些与任务有关的目标仍然无人知晓,并寻求填补这些空白的意见,这种模式将是有益的。

blocks.en: GT trajectory RGB improves accuracy further with a jointly changed view set and exploration context. Remaining errors suggest that VLMs need to recognize the same object across viewpoints and combine separate observations into consistent judgments of object counts and spatial relations.
blocks.zh: GT轨迹RGB随着共同改变视野和探索背景而进一步提高了准确性. 所剩错误表明,VLMs需要从不同角度识别同一物体,并将单独的观测结果合并到对物体计数和空间关系的一致判断.

blocks.en: With RGB views and order unchanged, adding depth, pose, and calibration jointly gives the highest accuracy. The gain highlights the value of relating objects across views to physical distances and camera positions, beyond recognizing them in individual images. Remaining errors suggest that VLMs also need to connect these measurements to the specific comparison or direction the question asks about.
blocks.zh: 由于RGB视图和顺序不变,增加了深度,姿势,并联合校正,给出了最高的准确度. 收益凸显了将不同视点的物体与物理距离和相机位置相联系的价值,除了在单个图像中识别外。 所余错误表明,VLMs还需要将这些测量与问题所问的具体比较或方向联系起来.

blocks.en: 5.4 Human Analysis of Exploration Gaps
blocks.zh: 5.4 探索差距的人类分析

blocks.en: Human evaluators categorize all 206 gap cases ( A = 1 \mathrm{A}=1 , N = 0 \mathrm{N}=0 ) across the 1,750 VLM episodes. Categories distinguish target observations, search scope, landmarks, and access or event verification. Of the 100 non-path cases, 85 miss required-object observations. One model correctly answers six mirrors while observing only five. Another observes all four side tables but leaves a required room unexplored. These cases and unseen-view gains (Section 5.3 ) motivate collecting target views and tracking instances separately from search coverage.
blocks.zh: 人类评价人员在1,750个VLM分集中将所有206个缺口病例(A = 1\mathrm{A}=1,N = 0\mathrm{N}=0)分类. 类别区分目标观测、搜索范围、地标、访问或事件核查。 在100起非病理学病例中,85起误入目标观测。 一个模型正确回答六个镜像,同时只观测到五个. 另一组人观察了所有四个侧桌,但留下了未探索的所需房间。 这些案件和未见成果(第5.3节)促使收集目标意见和跟踪情况与搜索范围分开。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: ROAM-Bench evaluates exploration, spatial judgment, and goal-directed action through independent outcome and evidence checks. Human evaluators demonstrate successful task completion through the public observation and action interface. VLMs exhibit both correct outcomes with unmet task requirements and errors after stronger corroboration passes. Spatial-estimation and relocation failures further identify difficulties in grounding judgments and selecting the intended object. These findings motivate coherent cross-view instance representations, calibrated spatial judgment, and feedback-guided planning.
blocks.zh: ROAM-Bench通过独立的结果和证据检查来评价探索,空间判断,以及目标导向的行动. 人类评估人员通过公众观察和行动接口证明任务成功完成。 自愿授标显示的结果正确,任务要求未得到满足,在经过更严格的证实证后出现错误。 空间估计和迁移失败进一步查明了在判断依据和选择预定对象方面的困难。 这些结论激励了连贯的交叉观点实例表述、调整空间判断和反馈指导规划。

blocks.en: Task-required evidence conditions (N) operationalize the observations and interactions required by each task instruction and are frozen before model evaluation. They serve related but distinct purposes: observing relevant objects, covering the declared search scope, and completing specified exploration or interaction. A condition can serve more than one purpose. In path integration, public self-motion information supports the directional answer, while landmark observations check completion of the prescribed exploration. Counting-scope coverage checks that the agent searches the required rooms, including places where further instances might occur.
blocks.zh: 任务所需证据条件(N)将每项任务指示所要求的观察和互动付诸实施,并在模型评价前被冻结. 它们服务于相关但不同的目的:观察相关物体,涵盖申报的搜索范围,并完成特定的探索或互动。 一个条件可以服务于一个以上的目的. 在路径集成中,公共自动机信息支持方向答案,而地标观测则检查规定的探索完成情况. 清点范围,检查代理人搜查所需房间,包括可能发生更多情况的地方。

blocks.en: A qualifying observation passes the task’s target-visibility rule. Regions belonging to the same instance are combined, including disconnected regions. The VLM receives RGB images 768 pixels wide and 432 pixels high. We inspect the delivered RGB views to select the visibility criterion before evaluation. The same criterion defines the scorer’s clear-observation check. Repeated sightings are matched by instance ID across rounds. blocks.en: For surface contents, N requires observing the designated surface or container and every listed object. S also checks that the objects have the required support relations and qualifying observations. For room localization, N requires observing the target or an accepted same-kind object in the answer room, with any required opening before a hidden target is revealed. S adds a qualifying target observation and a consistent object-to-room assignment. A verified copy made from the same object template can satisfy S through its own observation and room assignment. blocks.en: Valid depth is finite and positive. The evaluator estimates each object’s position from the qualifying view in which it occupies the largest image region and has a valid depth-derived point. It samples the region’s center or a nearby point with representative depth. Distances are measured in the horizontal plane. blocks.en: Room-area N requires entering the target room. S requires at least three 90° yaw sectors observed inside it. The evaluator samples depth on a regular grid, with valid fraction at least 0.5 and an available median. Gap-width N observes both furniture referents. S uses finite depth-derived silhouette-edge points for both objects in the same observation, taking the minimum horizontal edge separation over eligible observations and comparing with the stored centimetre tolerance. Relative-direction N observes origin, forward reference, and target. S reconstructs the two horizontal bearings and matches the task sector within 22.5°. The object-based geometric checks also require qualifying object observations.
blocks.zh: 房间面积 N需要进入目标室。 S需要至少3个90°的 ya扇区被观测到. 评价人员在正常网格上取样深度,有效分数至少为0.5,可用中位数。 宽度 N观察两个家具裁判。 S在同一观测中,对两个物体使用有限度的深度衍生硅接点,在合格观测中采用最小水平边缘分离,并与所储存的厘米耐受性进行比较。 相对方向 N 观测来源、前向参考和目标。 S重建了两个水平轴承,并在22.5°以内与任务部门相匹配. 基于对象的几何检查还需要限定对象观测.

blocks.en: For path integration, N checks whether both specified landmarks are observed, regardless of order. S adds the required room and distinct-viewpoint coverage. For relocation, N requires successfully picking an accepted source and subsequently placing that same object at the destination. Any required opening precedes target visibility or pickup. When several sources are acceptable, each source is checked through its complete pick-and-place sequence.
blocks.zh: 对于路径集成,N检查是否遵守了两个指定的地标,无论顺序如何. S增加了所需的房间和独特的视野。 为了迁移,N需要成功地选择一个可接受的来源,然后将同一物体放置在目的地。 任何需要的开口都先于目标能见度或取出. 当几种来源可以接受时,每个来源都通过完整的取出和取出位置序列进行核对.

blocks.en: Each observation round supplies the inputs for the next skill or final answer. The interaction interface described in the main paper presents the task, sensor readings, action feedback, reference images, and the most recent 20 visual rounds. All image sources share a limit of 50 images per decision. Retrieved camera images and their original text can supplement this history. Intermediate camera frames from the preceding action are shown only at the first decision in a round. A path visualization and the latest camera image follow. Image-point actions refer only to that latest image.
blocks.zh: 每个观察回合为下一个技能或最后答案提供投入。 主论文所描述的交互界面介绍了任务,传感器读取,动作反馈,参考图像,以及最近20个视觉回合. 所有图像来源共享每个决定50个图像的限制. 获取相机图像及其原始文本可以补充这个历史. 以上动作的中间相机相框仅在第一轮裁判时显示. 一个路径可视化和最新的相机图像随之而来. 图像点动作只指最新的图像.

blocks.en: At the first decision, the agent may retain selected intermediate frames. The default retains none, and the selection remains unchanged for the round. Before executing a skill or submitting an answer or completion report, the agent may retrieve earlier observations at most twice, with at most 12 archived images in total. Empty or invalid retrieval requests count toward this limit. Retrieval updates the context without changing the environment or advancing the observation round. Navigation and interaction skills produce the next round’s inputs. An answer or completion report ends the episode and triggers independent evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在第一项决定中,代理人可以保留选定的中间帧。 默认保留了无,且该回合的选择保持不变。 在执行技能或提交答复或完成报告之前,代理人最多可取回两次先前的观测结果,总共最多取回12个存档图像。 空取或无效取回请求数到此限制 。 检索在不改变环境或推进观测回合的情况下更新上下文. 导航和互动技能产生下一轮的投入。 答复或完成报告结束插曲并触发独立评价。

blocks.en: Latest camera images and retained intermediate frames enter the recent visual history and retrieval archive. blocks.en: 10 Task Difficulty Across Models

blocks.zh: 我们通过7个模型衡量每个任务的答案准确性,每个模型贡献一次。 分母为七分,为一分任务.

blocks.en: We hold out each of the 27 scenes in turn and estimate task-type means from the remaining scenes. These means reduce squared prediction error by 41.46% relative to the training-mean baseline, showing that task type helps predict difficulty across the benchmark environments.
blocks.zh: 我们依次抓出27个场景中的每一个场景,并从其余场景中估计任务类型的手段. 这意味着,相对于训练目的基线,将平方预测错误减少41.46%,表明任务类型有助于预测整个基准环境的困难。

blocks.en: Twenty-nine tasks receive no correct answer from any of the seven models. These shared failures indicate task difficulties that persist across models with different overall scores. Appendix 12 provides human-verified analysis of object visibility and behavior across all seven models.

blocks.en: 11 Episode-Level Diagnostics

blocks.en: The VLM analyses in Appendices 11 – 13 use the same 1,750 episodes (250 tasks per model). Here we summarize outcome gaps, relocation milestones, numerical errors, and action costs. Relocation uses the 210-episode subset (30 tasks per model). Human review categorizes all 206 gap cases (A=1,N=0) here, examines localizability and behavior in 307 sampled episodes (Appendix 12.1 ), and directly audits N/S in 200 episodes (Appendix 12.2 ). Appendix 13 breaks down the scores and relocation stages by model.

blocks.en: 11.1 Correctness and Task Completion
blocks.zh: 11.1 正确性和完成任务

blocks.en: Excluding path integration, 100 of 1,540 episodes yield correct outcomes with unmet task requirements (6.5 percentage points). In model order from Table S8 , these counts are 17, 16, 10, 16, 18, 17, and 6, each over 220 tasks. They concern required target observations, search coverage, or access and interaction checks. Path integration adds 106 cases of unmet landmark exploration, while start and final poses supply direction information. Table S8 reports per-model gap cases (A=1,N=0), their fraction of all episodes (G), and their fraction of correct outcomes.
blocks.zh: 不包括路径整合,1 540集中有100集产生正确结果,未达到任务要求(6.5个百分点)。 根据表S8的模型顺序,这些计数是17、16、10、16、18、17和6,每个计数超过220个任务。 它们涉及需要目标观察、搜索范围或访问和互动检查。 路径集成增加了106起未达到里程碑的探索案例,而开始和最终则提供了供应方向信息。 表S8按模式报告差距案例(A=1,N=0),占所有事件的比例(G),占正确结果的比例。

blocks.en: Table S8: Gap cases are correct outcomes with unmet task-required evidence (A=1,N=0). G divides this count by all 250 episodes per model; gap among correct divides it by A-passing episodes. Brackets show whole-scene bootstrap percentiles.
blocks.zh: 表S8:差距案件是没有达到任务要求的正确结果(A=1、N=0)。 G将这个计数除以每个模型的全部250集;在正确除以A-passing分出的差距. 斑点显示全场的靴子百分位数。

blocks.en: We manually inspect and categorize all 206 gap cases (A=1,N=0) using their task requirements and corresponding observation and interaction records. Tables S9 and S10 separate object observations, search scope, landmarks, and access or event verification. One episode belongs to two categories. Of the 100 non-path cases, 85 fail required-object observation checks. Target coverage is thus the principal non-landmark shortfall, distinct from search completeness and prescribed procedures.
blocks.zh: 我们利用206个空白案件(A=1,N=0)的任务要求以及相应的观察和互动记录进行人工检查和分类。 表S9和S10分别对对象观测,搜索范围,地标,访问或事件验证. 一集属于两类. 在100起非病理学病例中,85起未能按要求进行目标观察。 因此,目标覆盖面是主要的非地标缺口,不同于搜索完整性和规定程序。

blocks.en: Table S9: Manual categorization of all 206 gap cases ( A = 1 , N = 0 A=1,N=0 ). Obj.: incomplete relevant-object observations. Scope: unmet prescribed room coverage. Land.: unobserved required landmarks. Inter.: unmet or unverified access/event checks. These seven episodes have an unverified initial placement relation; one also lacks the required ordered events. Columns overlap. Multi. counts episodes in at least two categories.
blocks.zh: 表S9:所有206个差距病例的人工分类(A=1;N=0 A=1;N=0)。 obj.:不完整的相关对象观测. 范围:未达到规定的房间覆盖率。 土地:未观测到的地标。 Inter.:未实现或未经核实的访问/活动检查。 这七集的初始投放关系未经核实;一集也缺乏必要的定点事件. 列相重叠. 多个,至少分为两类。

blocks.en: Table S10: Manual categorization by model of gap cases ( A = 1 , N = 0 A=1,N=0 ). Categories and overlap follow Table S9 .
blocks.zh: 表S10:按差距案例模式进行人工分类(A=1;N=0 A=1;N=0)。 类别和重叠情况见表S9。

blocks.en: Two recorded examples distinguish target observations from search coverage. In scene_107, GPT-6.1-sol reports the correct total of six mirrors, but its delivered observations cover only five required mirror instances, omitting the guest-lounge mirror. In scene_139, Kimi K3.1 Pro reports the correct total of four side tables and observes all four, but does not complete the required room coverage, missing the steam room. Both pass A and fail N and T. The first lacks a required target observation, while the second fails a prescribed search condition despite observing all counted targets.
blocks.zh: 记录的两个例子将目标观测与搜索覆盖区分开来. 在scene_107中,GPT-6.1-sol报告了正确的总共6个镜像,但其交付的观测只覆盖了需要的5个镜像实例,省略了来宾-lounge镜像. 在现场_139, Kimi K3.1 Pro报告正确共4张侧桌并观察了全部4张,但没有完成所需的房间覆盖,错过了蒸汽室. 两个都通过A并失败了N和T. 第一种缺乏所需的目标观察,而第二种则尽管观察了所有被统计的目标,却未能达到规定的搜索条件.

blocks.en: 11.2 Relocation Milestones
blocks.zh: 11.2 搬迁里程碑

blocks.en: Figure S2 : Relocation across seven models. Left: successive stages over 210 episodes. Placement requires a preceding pick of the same acceptable object. Destination support adds a post-placement check of the released object. Right: pre-pick and post-place views from a successful GPT-6-astra episode.
blocks.zh: 图S2:跨越7个模型的搬迁. 左:相继相继有210集. 放置需要事先选取同一可接受的物体。 目标支持添加了释放对象的后置检查. 右:从成功的GPT-6-astra插曲中预选和后位取景.

blocks.en: Across the 210 relocation episodes, 94 successfully pick an acceptable target, 56 subsequently place the same object at the specified destination, and 40 pass the destination-support check after placement. Milestones use recorded event order, including events within one observation round, following the relocation rules in Appendix 7 .
blocks.zh: 在210起搬迁事件中,94起成功选择了可接受的目标,56起随后在指定的目的地放置同一物体,40起在放置后通过目的地支持检查. 里程碑采用记录的事件顺序,包括按照附录7中的迁移规则在一个观察回合内发生的事件。

blocks.en: These milestones count pickup, placement, and support events. N and S additionally require the applicable access checks, while A checks the final goal state. Later actions can change the final state after a successful placement.
blocks.zh: 这些里程碑点数了接货、安置和支助活动。 N和S另外要求适用的访问检查,而A则检查最终入球状态. 后期行动可以在成功安置后改变最终状态.

blocks.en: We inspect all 210 episodes using the task’s acceptable target instances and the recorded pick events. A wrong-object pickup is a successful pick of an object outside this acceptable set. Of the 116 episodes without any correct pickup, 102 contain a wrong-object pickup without later correction (87.9%). Thus, target selection errors that remain uncorrected account for most failures before correct pickup. Per-model counts are also reported in Table S25 .
blocks.zh: 我们利用任务可接受的目标实例和记录的选取事件来检查所有210个事件。 错误对象取取就是在这个可接受的集合之外成功取取取对象. 在116个没有正确接取的事件中,102个包含一个错误对象接取而无需事后更正(87.9%). 因此,目标选择出错仍未纠正,这说明在正确选择之前,大多数失误都存在。 表S25还报告了每个模型的计数。

blocks.en: Among the 116 episodes without a correct pickup, 36 contain a failed pick action. Fourteen contain failed picks at two or more distinct action steps. These categories can overlap with wrong-object pickup. Across all 210 episodes, 20 reach a correct pickup after a failed pick action, and 15 reach a correct pickup after a wrong-object pickup. These events show that recovery is possible, while the 102 uncorrected wrong-object episodes identify target verification and correction as major weaknesses.
blocks.zh: 在116集中,没有正确的取取,36集包含一个失败取取取动作. 14 包含两个或多个不同动作步骤的失败选择。 这些类别可以与错误对象的接取相重叠. 在所有210集中,20集在采收行动失败后到达正确的取取地,而15集在错误的取取取地后到达正确的取取地. 这些事件表明恢复是可能的,而102个未修正的错误对象事件将目标校正和校正确定为主要弱点.

blocks.en: The recorded actions illustrate how a strategy change can still fail to address the problem. In a DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash proof-card episode, two successive pick actions select different image points. Both receive feedback that the point lies on a floor, wall, or ceiling and the arm does not move. In a GPT-5.6-sol kettle episode, the model moves sideways and forward after reachability failures. The next pick still reports no reachable arm pose, and a later successful pick holds a different object. These episodes show attempts to adjust actions, but inadequate correction of the selected point or target identity. They motivate using feedback to decide whether to change the grasp point, approach position, or selected object, then checking the result in the next image.
blocks.zh: 记录的行动表明,改变战略仍然不能解决问题。 在一出DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的证明卡插曲中,相继有两次取出动作选择了不同的图像点. 两者都得到反馈,认为点位于地上,墙上,或天花板上,手臂不动. 在一出GPT-5.6-溶液壶相中,模型在可达性故障后会移动侧道并前进. 下一个选手仍然报告没有可伸手的手臂姿势,后来成功的选手则持有不同的物体. 这些剧集显示了调整动作的尝试,但对所选点或目标身份的校正不足. 它们激励使用反馈来决定是改变取取点,接近位置,还是选择对象,然后在下一张图像中检查结果.

blocks.en: 11.3 Numerical Estimation Errors
blocks.zh: 11.3 数值估计出错

blocks.en: Answer accuracy alone does not show the size of numerical errors. Each model answers the same 20 tasks in each of three numerical types. We convert parsed answers to the task’s scoring units and measure absolute error, relative error, and absolute error divided by the answer tolerance. A normalized error of one is the acceptance boundary. Error summaries use parseable answers, with coverage reported for every model and task type.
blocks.zh: 仅回答精度并不能显示数值错误的大小. 每个模型在三种数字类型中都回答相同的20个任务. 我们将解析的答案转换为任务的评分单位,并测量绝对错误、相对错误和绝对错误,除以答案容忍度。 一个正常错误是接受边界。 出错摘要使用可解析的答案,每个模型和任务类型都报告覆盖范围.

blocks.en: Two human evaluators independently estimate all 20 tasks in each numerical type, giving 40 judgments per type and 120 overall. They receive the public task materials and standardized RGB views containing the targets, with depth, reference values, and tolerances withheld. This experiment evaluates numerical estimation from supplied views, separately from the 100-task human active-exploration evaluation.
blocks.zh: 两名人评价员独立估计了每种数字类型的所有20项任务,对每种类型作出40项判断,对总共120项判断。 他们收到公共任务材料和包含目标、深度、参考值和容忍度的标准RGB观点。 该实验从所提供的观点中评价数值估计,与100任务人类活探索评价分开.

blocks.en: Table S13 reports absolute and relative errors, acceptance rates, and agreement. Default tolerances accept 110/120 estimates (91.7%), compared with 93/120 (77.5%) and 64/120 (53.3%) at the tighter scales. Acceptance spans 87.5–95.0% across the three task types, with ICC(2,1) of 0.76–0.84. These results place the binary thresholds against human visual estimates. The continuous errors and tighter-score results preserve a separate measure of precision.
blocks.zh: 表S13报告了绝对错误和相对错误、接受率和协议。 默认容忍度接受110/120的估计数(91.7%),而更严格的尺度为93/120(77.5%)和64/120(53.3%)。 三种任务类型的接受率为87.5-95.0%,ICC(2,1)为0.76-0.84。 这些结果使二进制阈值与人类的视觉估计值相抵. 连续错误和收紧分数的结果保持了单独的精确度。

blocks.en: Table S13 : Independent human numerical estimates under the three tolerance scales. Two human evaluators each judge 20 tasks per type. MAE uses task units. ICC(2,1) measures single-rater absolute agreement under a two-way random-effects model. The pooled row combines judgments across types.
blocks.zh: 表S13:三个容忍尺度下独立的人类数字估计。 每个类型有两名人评价员判断20项任务。 MAE使用任务单元. ICC(2,1)在双向随机效应模型下测量单方-绝对协议. 集合行将各种类型的判断结合起来。

Answers, parsed values, trajectories, N/S checks, and other task rules remain fixed. The original scale reproduces all main-result counts. Unparseable answers remain incorrect. Scores and paired differences use the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 10,000 whole-scene bootstrap resamples across the same 27 scenes (seed 20261113). Each resampled scene retains all of its tasks and models.

blocks.en: Table S14 shows that halving all three tolerances lowers overall T by 0.8–4.0 percentage points. Overall A and T rankings retain their order at both tighter settings, with GPT-6-astra highest and the Sonnet–Kimi A tie broken in favor of Sonnet. Tables S15 – S17 give each numerical task type. Distance and area have pairwise rank reversals, reported with paired intervals in Table S18 . Gap width preserves every originally strict ordering, with some ties separating at the half scale.
