blocks.en: 11.4 Action Cost
blocks.zh: 11.4 行动费用

blocks.en: Failed episodes also consume actions. We therefore report mean actions over all episodes, mean actions among strict task successes, and total actions divided by strict task successes. The last measure includes failure costs. All 250 episodes per model have recorded high-level action counts. GPT-5.6-sol uses fewer actions on strict task successes than GPT-6.1-sol (40.96 versus 46.27), yet its total cost per success is higher (386.00 versus 108.60). Reliable completion can therefore matter more than shortening successful episodes.
blocks.zh: 失败事件也会消耗动作. 因此,我们报告指的是在所有情况下的行动,是指严格任务成功中的行动,以及以严格任务成功相划分的全部行动。 最后一项措施包括失败费用。 每个模型的所有250集都记录了高级别行动计数。 GPT-5.6-sol在严格任务成功方面使用的行动少于GPT-6.1-sol(40.96对46.27),然而其每次成功的总成本(386.00对108.60)更高. 因此,可靠的完成可能比缩短成功事例更重要。

blocks.en: Table S19: Action cost across seven models. All 250 episodes per model have known action counts. Brackets show whole-scene bootstrap percentiles. The last column includes actions spent on failures.
blocks.zh: 表S19:七种模式的行动成本。 每个模型的250集都已经知道动作计数。 斑点显示全场的靴子百分位数。 最后一栏包括用于失败的行动。

blocks.en: 12 Visual and Behavioral Evidence Review
blocks.zh: 12 视觉和行为证据审查

blocks.en: Figure S3 : Human review of exploration evidence across seven evaluated models. Reference images, exploration frames, and action feedback support manually checked object-localization and behavioral judgments. Tiles show paired-judgment availability for 84 recorded cases. Camera thumbnails illustrate the inputs using a GPT-6-astra relocation episode.
blocks.zh: 图S3:7个评价模型的勘探证据的人类审查。 参考图像,探索框架,动作反馈支持手动检查对象本地化和行为判断. 平面显示84起记录在案的案件可进行对等判决。 相机缩略图使用GPT-6-astra的迁移插曲来说明输入.

blocks.en: 12.1 Human Review Protocol
blocks.zh: 12.1 人审查议定书

blocks.en: The 307-case review examines which objects can be localized and which behaviors occur in the recorded trajectories. This differs from the 200-episode audit of individual N/S conditions in Appendix 12.2 . The 307 cases are sampled from the 1,750 VLM episodes, grouped by model, task specification, and strict task success. Each stratum contains up to two recorded cases, with weights reflecting the episodes it represents. All 307 cases have usable primary labels.
blocks.zh: 307个案例的审查检查了哪些物体可以被本地化,哪些行为发生在所记录的轨迹中. 这不同于附录12.2中对个别N/S条件的200集审计。 307个案例从1,750个VLM事件抽样,按模式,任务规格,严格任务成功分类. 每个层包含多达两起被记录的病例,其分量反映了它所代表的几起事件. 所有307个案例都有可用的主要标签。

blocks.en: We examine original reference images, camera observations, action sequences, and feedback. Evidence packets contain up to six camera frames and feedback excerpts, covering the trajectory and its first and last object interactions. We verify cited object locations and behavior against these records.
blocks.zh: 我们审查原始的参考图像、相机观测、动作序列和反馈。 证据包包含最多6个相机帧和反馈节录,涵盖轨迹及其第一和最后一个物体的相互作用. 我们对照这些记录核实所引用的物体位置和行为。

blocks.en: The human evaluations involve simulator-based task completion, numerical estimation from rendered views, and annotation of model trajectories. We do not seek formal ethics review because we consider these simulator-based evaluations low risk and collect no identifying personal information. All participants provide informed consent for participation and publication of aggregate results, and we report only these aggregate results.
blocks.zh: 人类评价包括模拟器任务完成、从所提供观点得出的数字估计和模型轨迹的注释。 我们并不寻求正式的道德操守审查,因为我们认为这些以模拟器为基础的评价风险较低,没有收集识别个人信息。 所有参与者都对参与和公布总体结果提供知情同意,我们只报告这些总体结果。

blocks.en: 12.2 Human Audit of N and S
blocks.zh: 12.2 南北审计

blocks.en: For direct comparison with automatic N/S scores, the separate 200-episode audit covers all seven models, 11 task types, and passing and failing N/S outcomes. It applies the task-specific rules in Appendix 7 . With model identity, final answers, and automatic scores hidden, one annotator checks whether task-relevant objects appear in the delivered views and whether the recorded exploration and interactions meet each applicable N/S condition. Image, sensor, and event records support the checks, and each judgment cites its frame or event.
blocks.zh: 为了同自动N/S分数进行直接比较,单独的200集审计涵盖所有7个模型,11个任务类型,以及通过和失败的N/S分数. 它适用附录7中的具体任务规则。 利用模型身份、最后答案和自动分数隐藏,一名注释员检查与任务有关的物体是否出现在已交付的视图中,以及所记录的探索和互动是否符合每个适用的N/S条件。 图像、传感器和事件记录支持检查,每个判决都引用其框架或事件。

blocks.en: N and S are ratable in 196 and 194 episodes, respectively. Table S20 reports the raw comparison with automatic scores. Table S21 gives unweighted agreement, false-positive rates, and false-negative rates, with the single-annotator judgments as the reference. Agreement is 97.4% for N and 93.3% for S. This close agreement supports automatic checks of the task-required observations and interactions in N and the additional corroboration in S. Answer correctness is measured independently.
blocks.zh: N和S分别在196集和194集可评出. 表S20报告与自动分数的原始比较。 表S21给出了未加权的约定,假阳性比率和假阴性比率,以单注释者判断为参考. 协议为N为97.4%,S为93.3%. 这一密切协议支持自动检查任务要求的观测和N中的互动,以及S. Answer中的额外确证正确性是独立测量的.

blocks.en: Table S20: Automatic checks against human judgments in 200 episodes. TP/TN agree; FP is an automatic pass with a human failure, and FN is the reverse.
blocks.zh: 表S20:200集中人类判断的自动检查. TP/TN同意;FP是带有人性故障的自动通路,而FN则是倒道.

blocks.en: Table S21: Unweighted rule-audit rates: agreement ( TP + TN ) / n (\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{TN})/n , FP rate FP / ( FP + TN ) \mathrm{FP}/(\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{TN}) , and FN rate FN / ( FN + TP ) \mathrm{FN}/(\mathrm{FN}+\mathrm{TP}) .
blocks.zh: 表S21:未加权规则审计率:协议 (TP + TN)/n (\mathrm{TP + mathrm{TN})/n,FP 比率 FP / (FP + TN)\mathrm{FP}/ (\mathrm{FP + + mathrm{TN}),和FN 比率 FN / (FN + TP)\mathrm{FN} (\mathrm{FN + + mathrm{TP}).

blocks.en: 12.3 Object Localizability and Task-Required Evidence
blocks.zh: 12.3 目标地点和任务要求证据

blocks.en: Four categories distinguish insufficient evidence, a referent that cannot be localized in the supplied views, ambiguous localization, and clear localization. A clear label requires a relevant referent, camera-frame ID, and normalized bounding box. It establishes that at least one relevant object or region can be localized in the recorded views.
blocks.zh: 4个类别区分了证据不足、无法在所提供观点中本地化的参考文献、模糊本地化和清晰本地化。 清晰的标签需要相关的指针,相机帧ID,以及规范的边框. 它规定,在所记录的视图中至少可以有一个相关物体或区域本地化.

blocks.en: Table S22: Human-verified object localizability in recorded exploration views across seven models. Clear labels require a camera-frame bounding box for at least one relevant object or region. Weights reflect episode counts within model, task specification, and strict task success strata.
blocks.zh: 表S22:7个模型中记录的勘探观点中经人验证的物体可定位性. 清晰的标签需要至少一个相关物体或区域的相机框边框. 重量在模型、任务规格和严格的任务成功阶层中反映各集数。

blocks.en: Within the 307-case review sample, weighted clear localizability is 79.5% overall and 71.2% among its 35 cases with A=1 and N=0. These 35 cases are a subset of the 206 gaps categorized in Appendix 11.1 . A stricter check requires a localization for every supplied non-option reference. This holds in 148 of 281 eligible cases, with weighted prevalence 45.3%. Reference roles follow their caption format, excluding option and encoded-choice labels. The manually confirmed localizations show that identifiable targets can coexist with unmet N conditions, such as observing every counted instance or covering the required rooms. S additionally checks task-specific corroboration, including geometric measurements.
blocks.zh: 在307个案例审查抽样中,加权的可确定性总体为79.5%,在有A=1和N=0的35个案例中为71.2%。 这35个案例是附录11.1所分类的206个空白中的一个子集。 更严格的检查要求每个提供的非选项引用都本地化. 在281个合格病例中,148个属于这种情况,加权流行率为45.3%。 引用角色遵循其标题格式,不包括选项和编码选择标签. 人工确认的本地化表明,可识别的目标可以与未满足的N条件并存,例如观察每一个已计数的实例或覆盖所需的房间. 进一步检查具体任务确证,包括几何测量.

blocks.en: 12.4 Consistency of Recorded Judgments
blocks.zh: 12.4 有记录的判决的一致性

blocks.en: We manually verify two sets of recorded localization judgments for 84 cases. Of these, 76 have usable pairs and eight have unavailable pairs. Category agreement is 85.5%, with Cohen’s κ = 0.595 \kappa=0.595 . Assigning agreement or disagreement to all unavailable pairs gives a sensitivity range of 77.4–86.9%.
blocks.zh: 我们人工核查了84个案件的两套记录的本地化判决。 其中76对有可用的配对,有8对没有可用的配对. 类别协议为85.5%, Cohen = 0.595\kappa = 0.595。 向所有无法使用的对子分配协议或不同意见的敏感度范围为77.4-86.9%。

blocks.en: Both recorded judgments label 57 cases clearly localizable. They identify a common frame–referent pair in 55, and corresponding boxes reach an intersection-over-union of at least 0.5 in 54. These manually checked comparisons describe consistency in category labels and object localization.
blocks.zh: 这两起判决都标出57起明显可查的案件。 它们识别出55个中常见的相框-相框对,相对应的相框可以达到54个中至少0.5个相框相接. 这些手工检查的比较描述类别标签和对象本地化的一致性.

blocks.en: We also check the recorded image controls for exact image matching, blank-image handling, and simple object counting. Both sets of judgments meet the predefined control criteria. A camera-withholding control retains reference images and actions while removing exploration frames. Clear labels fall from 20 of 24 original judgments to zero without the camera images. This confirms that these localization judgments depend on the exploration images.
blocks.zh: 我们还检查记录的图像控制 精确的图像匹配 空白图像处理 和简单的对象计数 。 这两套判决都符合预定的控制标准。 取相机控制保留了参考图像和动作,同时去除勘探框架. 清晰的标签从24个原判中的20个降为零,没有相机图像. 这证实了这些本地化判断取决于勘探图像.

blocks.en: 12.5 Observable Behavior and Skill Constraints
blocks.zh: 12.5 可观察的行为和技能限制

blocks.en: We manually check overlapping labels for difficult views, possible instance confusion, repeated search, explicit navigation or interaction failures, metric estimates without recorded measurement support, and incomplete task-required coverage. Every label requires a frame or action citation. An episode can receive several labels.
blocks.zh: 我们手动检查重叠的标签,以获取困难的视图、可能的实例混淆、重复搜索、明确的导航或互动失败、没有记录的测量支持的计量估计以及不完全的任务要求覆盖。 每个标签都需要一个帧或动作引用. 一个剧集可以收到多个标签.

blocks.en: We identify explicit constraint reports in the same 307 reviewed cases using fixed text rules. Table S23 reports unweighted episode and event counts, and weighted prevalence among T-failing and T-passing episodes. Positive reports can occur in episodes that later succeed.
blocks.zh: 在同一307个经审查的案件中,我们使用固定文本规则确定明确的限制报告。 表S23报告未加权的插曲和事件数,以及T-failing和T-assing的加权流行率。 积极的报告可以发生在后来成功的事件中。

blocks.en: Table S23: Constraint reports in the 307 reviewed cases. Episode and event counts are unweighted; percentages are weighted prevalence conditional on T failure or success. Constraints can overlap and occur before successful recovery. Brackets show whole-scene bootstrap percentiles.
blocks.zh: 表S23:307个审查案件中的限制性报告。 百分数和事件计数不加权;百分数的加权流行率取决于T的失败或成功. 制约因素可能相互重叠并发生于成功恢复之前。 斑点显示全场的靴子百分位数。

blocks.en: Obstacle reports are common in both T failures and successes, whereas arm targets on room surfaces and unreachable arm poses are more prevalent among failures. These patterns identify physically valid interaction targets and reachable approaches as useful checks alongside feedback-guided recovery.
blocks.zh: 障碍性报告常见于T故障和成功,而室内表面的臂口目标及无法接触的臂面则更常见于故障. 这些模式将物理上有效的互动目标和可达到的方法确定为有用的检查以及反馈指导的恢复。

blocks.en: 12.6 Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: 12.6 统计分析

blocks.en: Localizability and behavioral estimates use the recorded stratum weights. Their ranges are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 10,000 whole-scene resamples. The N/S rule audit reports direct unweighted counts and rates.
blocks.zh: 局部性和行为估计使用所记录的地层权重. 其范围为一万个整场复刻图中的2.5分和97.5分之. 不适用规则的审计报告直接未经加权的清点和费率。

blocks.en: 13 Evidence-Based Model Profiles
blocks.zh: 13 循证示范简介

blocks.en: Using the episode scores analyzed in Appendix 11 , we compare each model’s spatial-answer errors after observation checks pass and its relocation failure stages. The human review in Appendix 12 helps interpret the objects and behavior behind these patterns.
blocks.zh: 使用附录11分析的分数,我们比较了每个模型在观察检查合格后及其迁移失败阶段的空间回答错误。 附录12中的人类评论有助于解释这些模式背后的物体和行为.

blocks.en: 13.1 Conditional Errors and Relocation Stages
blocks.zh: 13.1 有条件的错误和搬迁阶段

blocks.en: We examine spatial-answer errors after N passes, with additional analyses after S passes, and locate failures along the pick-and-place sequence. Recorded scores, interaction events, camera views, and additional archived observations connect these measurements to each episode.
blocks.zh: 我们检查N出后空间答题错误,S出后进行额外分析,并按取出和取出位置顺序查找出错. 所记录的分数,交互事件,相机视图,以及额外的存档观测将这些测量与每集相接.

blocks.en: For G1–G4, P ⁡ ( A = 0 ∣ N = 1 ) P(A=0\mid N=1) measures incorrect outcomes among episodes passing task-required evidence checks (Table S24 ). For G2 and G3, conditioning on both N and S examines errors after stronger corroboration also passes (Table S26 ). Each cell reports errors over episodes passing the stated N/S checks. G4 combines relative direction and path integration.
blocks.zh: 对于G1–G4,P → (A = 0 → N = 1) P(A = 0\\mid N = 1),通过任务要求的证据检查(表S24),衡量各事件结果不正确。 就G2和G3而言,在N和S两个方面都检查了经过更有力证实后的错误(表S26)。 每个单元格在通过说明的N/S检查时报告出错。 G4结合了相对方向和路径融合.

blocks.en: Using the milestones in Appendix 11.2 , we assign episodes with incorrect relocation outcomes (A=0) to three stages: before correct pick, after correct pick but before correct place, and after correct place with the final goal unmet. The stages partition A failures within the same 210 relocation episodes. Uncorrected wrong-object pickup is an additional label that can overlap these stages.
blocks.zh: 我们利用附录11.2中的里程碑,将迁移结果不正确的事件(A=0)分为三个阶段:在正确选择之前,在正确选择之后,但在正确位置之后,在最终目标未实现之后。 在相同的210个迁移事件中,阶段分区A失败. 未更正的错误对象接取器是可与这些相重叠的附加标签.

blocks.en: Table S24 : Incorrect outcomes among N-passing episodes. Cells give errors/episodes in grounding (G1), aggregation (G2), geometry (G3), and reference-frame integration (G4).
blocks.zh: 表S24: N-通过事件结果不正确。 单元格在地平面(G1),聚合(G2),几何(G3)和参照框架整合(G4)中给出出错/异同.

blocks.en: Table S25 : Relocation failure stages (30 tasks/model). The three stage columns partition A failures. Pre-place follows correct pickup; post-place follows ordered correct placement. Wrong counts uncorrected wrong-object pickups and can overlap these stages.
blocks.zh: 表S25:搬迁故障阶段(30项任务/模式)。 三相分出 A 失败 。 前置位置跟踪正确的接车;后置位置跟踪命令正确接车。 错误计数未修正的错误对象取出,并可能与这些相重叠.

blocks.en: Table S26 : Incorrect counting (G2) and geometry (G3) answers among episodes passing both N and S. Cells give errors over episodes passing N and S.
blocks.zh: 表S26:通过N和S两个小节的不正确计数(G2)和几何(G3)答案。

blocks.en: 13.2 Model Profiles
blocks.zh: 13.2 示范简介

blocks.en: The profiles highlight each model’s main spatial-answer and relocation difficulties. Conditional fractions refer to N-passing episodes unless both N and S are stated. Relocation failure counts refer to A=0; T additionally requires the task’s observation and interaction checks.
blocks.zh: 简介突出了每个模型的主要空间答案和迁移困难。 有条件分数指N-通过分数,除非同时表示N和S. 迁移失败计数是指A=0;T另外要求任务观察和交互检查.

blocks.en: Among N-passing episodes, GPT-5.6-sol answers 14/19 aggregation questions and 18/31 geometric questions incorrectly. Of its 28 relocation failures, 21 occur before correct pickup, and 20 include an uncorrected wrong-object pick. Reliable counting across views and verification of the picked object’s identity are therefore priorities.
blocks.zh: 在N-通过事件中,GPT-5.6-sol错误地回答14/19汇总问题和18/31几何问题. 在其28起搬迁失败中,21起发生在正确的取回之前,20起包括未更正的错误取取物。 因此,对所选对象的看法进行可靠计算并核实其身份是优先事项。

blocks.en: GPT-6.1-sol has 15/28 aggregation errors and 14/68 geometric errors after N passes. Its relocation failures split 15/9/3 across the three stages. The nine failures between correct pickup and placement identify reliable transfer as a priority alongside cross-view counting.
blocks.zh: GPT-6.1-索尔有15/28的汇总错误和N后14/68的几何错误. 其搬迁失败在三个阶段分出15/9/3。 在正确收货和安放之间的九起失误中,将可靠的转移与交叉查看计数一起确定为优先事项。

blocks.en: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash has 17/27 grounding errors, 23/30 geometric errors, and 8/10 reference-frame errors after N passes. Of 29 relocation failures, 25 occur before correct pickup. Only five of the 30 tasks reach correct pickup. Reference-frame judgment and intended-target pickup are clear improvement targets.
blocks.zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash有17/27个地平面误差,23/30个几何误差,以及N通后8/10个参照帧误差. 在29起搬迁失败中,25起发生在正确的接车之前。 在30项任务中,只有5项能够正确完成。 参照框架的判断和预期目标选择是明确的改进目标。

blocks.en: Claude Sonnet 5.5 has 33/50 geometric errors after N passes, compared with 5/36 grounding errors. After both N and S pass, geometric errors remain at 26/40, including 9/9 gap-width questions. Relocation failures split 12/5/4 across the stages. Gap-width reasoning and target verification before pickup are therefore priorities.
blocks.zh: 克洛德·索内 5.5在N出道后有33/50的几何误差,相较于5/36的入地误差. 在N和S两通后,几何误差仍为26/40,包括9/9间隙-width问题. 搬迁失败在各阶段分出12/5/4。 因此,先进行差距推理和目标核查是优先事项。

blocks.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro has 20/28 aggregation errors and 30/50 geometric errors after N passes. The corresponding N-and-S fractions are 16/23 and 24/43. Relocation failures split 16/8/2, with 15 uncorrected wrong-object pickups. Cross-view counting, geometric precision, and verification of the selected object are therefore priorities.
blocks.zh: 木卫一 K3.1 Pro有20/28汇总错误和30/50N通后几何错误. 相应的N-和-S分数为16/23和24/43. 迁移失败拆分出16/8/2,有15个未修正的错误对象取出. 因此,交叉视图计数、几何精确度和选定对象的核实是优先事项。

blocks.en: Claude Opus 5.5 has 35/62 geometric errors after N passes, compared with 5/37 grounding errors. Geometric errors remain at 27/54 after both checks pass, including 11/13 gap-width questions. Relocation failures split 13/5/2, with 12 uncorrected wrong-object pickups. Geometric precision and correct target pickup are therefore priorities.
blocks.zh: 克洛德·奥普斯 5.5在N出道后有35/62的几何误差,相较于5/37的地平面误差. 在两次检查合格后,包括11/13个差宽问题,几何误差仍为27/54。 迁出故障拆分出13/5/2,有12个未修正的错误对象取出. 因此,几何精确度和正确的目标取走是优先事项。

blocks.en: GPT-6-astra has 14/34 aggregation errors and 6/74 geometric errors after N passes. After N and S pass, these fractions are 12/27 and 4/68. Fourteen of its 20 relocation failures occur before correct pickup, all with uncorrected wrong-object picks. Fifteen episodes reach correct placement, but five still end without the accepted goal. With stronger geometry, cross-view counting, target verification, and final-state checks after placement become prominent improvement targets.
blocks.zh: GPT-6-astra有14/34的汇总错误和6/74的N通后几何错误. 在N和S通过后,这些分数为12/27和4/68. 其20起搬迁失败中,有14起发生在正确的接车之前,所有故障都带有未改正的错误对象接发。 15集达到了正确的定位,但有5集仍然没有达到公认的目标. 随着更强的几何,交叉取景计数,目标核查,以及放置后的最终状态检查成为显著的改进目标.

blocks.en: 13.3 Alignment with Related Error Analyses
blocks.zh: 13.3 与相关错误分析保持一致

blocks.en: EmbodiedBench [ 30 ] analyzes perception, reasoning, and planning errors along the agent pipeline. We similarly locate failures in recorded interaction stages. MMSI-Bench [ 31 ] separates grounding, overlap matching and scene reconstruction, situation-transformation reasoning, and spatial logic. Our conditional error rates connect spatial answers to the observations verified during an episode. OpenEQA [ 16 ] distinguishes episodic memory from active information gathering. Our history diagnostics examine how acquired views contribute to later answers.
blocks.zh: Emphyct Bench [30] 分析代理管道沿线的感知,推理和规划错误. 我们同样在有记录的互动阶段找到失败。 MMSI-Bench [31] 分离了地平线,重叠匹配和场景重建,情况-转换推理,以及空间逻辑. 我们有条件的误差率将空间答案与一集中核实的观测结果联系起来. OpenEQA [16] 区分了中枢记忆与活性信息采集. 我们的历史诊断研究了获得的观点如何有助于以后的答案。

blocks.en: 13.4 Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 13.4 可复制性

blocks.en: Episode records link task identities, scores, and interaction stages. Appendix 14 compares retrieval from each model’s history with target-view supplementation from other trajectories.
blocks.zh: Episode记录将任务身份,分数,和交互阶段联系起来. 附录14将每个模型历史的检索与其他轨道的目标视图补充进行比较。

blocks.en: 14 GT Retrieval and View Supplementation
blocks.zh: 14个GT 检索和查看补充

blocks.en: We compare recovering task-relevant observations from each model’s own exploration trajectory with supplying target observations beyond that trajectory. Both settings preserve the task, public references, accumulated exploration context, and answer instruction, modifying only the observations supplied before the final answer. Baseline outcomes are reused from each model’s original episode. Table S27 reports per-model results and their pooled totals.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了从每个模型自己的勘探轨迹中回收与任务有关的观测结果,并提供了超出该轨迹的目标观测结果。 两种设置都保留了任务,公开参考,累积的勘探上下文,以及回答指令,仅修改了最终答案之前提供的意见. 基线结果从每个模型的原始插曲中重复使用。 表S27按模式报告结果及其汇总总数。

blocks.en: Table S27: Correct answers/total (accuracy) on 139 questions per model. Both interventions retain each model’s own exploration context. View supplementation adds target observations beyond that trajectory. Original outcomes are reused.
blocks.zh: 表S27:每个模型139个问题的正确答案/总计(准确性)。 这两种干预措施都保留了每个模型自己的勘探背景。 视图补充增加了超过该轨迹的目标观测. 原始结果重新使用。

blocks.en: Eligible question-answering tasks require active exploration and have recoverable final-answer inputs, recorded task-target views, and generated GT trajectory observations covering the task targets. The common set contains 139 tasks in 26 scenes: 32 in G1, 34 in G2, 52 in G3, and 21 relative-direction tasks in G4. Each model retains its own original exploration history in both settings. The diagnostic changes only the final judgment call and measures answer accuracy.
blocks.zh: 符合资格的问答任务需要积极探索,并有可收回的最后回答投入,记录任务目标观点,生成覆盖任务目标的GT轨迹观测. 共同集共收录了26个场景中的139个任务:G1,32个;G2,34个;G3,52个;G4,21个相对方向任务. 每个模型在两种场合都保留了自己的原始勘探历史. 诊断只改变最后判断的呼声和测量的准确性。

blocks.en: We construct GT retrieval inputs by retrieving all frames containing task-relevant objects from each model’s archived trajectory before its original final answer. These frames are added to the retrieved observations in the final-answer context. The rest of the original context is retained, so this setting recovers evidence the model already encounters during exploration. The retrieved image count follows the available relevant frames in that trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们通过从每个模型的存档轨迹中取回包含任务相关对象的所有框架来构建 GT 检索输入, 在原始最后答案之前。 在最后回答语境中,这些框架被添加到已检索到的观察中. 原上下文的其余部分被保留下来,因此这个设置可以恢复模型在探索中已经遇到的证据. 取回的图像数遵循该轨迹中可用的相关框架。

blocks.en: We construct GT view supplementation inputs from target views recorded in other trajectories of the same task. We add these views to each model’s own final-answer context, including observations of targets it has not seen. GT retrieval recovers views already present in that model’s history, while supplementation can fill gaps in its target observations.
blocks.zh: 我们从同一任务的其他轨道记录的目标视图中构建 GT 视图补充输入。 我们把这些观点补充到每个模式自己的最后答案中,包括观察它没有看到的目标。 GT检索恢复了该模型历史中已经存在的观点,而补充则可以填补其目标观测的空白.

blocks.en: GT retrieval gives 481/973 correct answers (49.4%), compared with 440/973 (45.2%) in original episodes. GT view supplementation gives 568/973 (58.4%), an 8.9-percentage-point improvement over GT retrieval. All seven models improve in both comparisons. Retrieval gains range from 0.7 to 8.6 percentage points across models, and supplementation adds 2.9–20.9 points. These gains show that additional task-relevant observations can improve final spatial judgments. Supplementation supplies views beyond the original trajectory; view selection and image counts follow the construction described above.
blocks.zh: GT检索给出了481/973的正确答案(49.4%),而原作中为440/973(45.2%). GT视图补充给出了568/973(58.4%),比GT检索提高8.9%. 所有七个模型在两个比较中都有所改进。 各模型的检索收益从0.7至8.6个百分点不等,补充增加2.9至20.9个百分点。 这些成果表明,与任务相关的额外观测可以改进最后空间判断。 补充提供超出原轨的视图;视图选择和图像计数遵循上述构造。

blocks.en: 15 GT Trajectory and Spatial Sensors
blocks.zh: 15 GT 轨道和空间传感器

blocks.en: 15.1 GT Trajectory Inputs
blocks.zh: 15.1 GT 轨道输入

blocks.en: GT trajectory judgment replaces exploration context with generated GT trajectory observations, retaining the task question and public reference images. Models answer without further exploration. The set contains the same 139 active-exploration tasks used for the historical-image comparisons.
blocks.zh: GT轨迹判断用生成的GT轨迹观测来取而代之地取而代之,保留了任务问题和公众参考图像. 模型解答后没有进一步探索. 该集包含用于历史-图像比较的相同的139个活性探索任务.

blocks.en: Table S28: GT trajectory judgments on 139 questions per model. Both conditions use identical RGB views.
blocks.zh: 表S28:GT对每个模型139个问题的轨迹判断. 两种条件都使用相同的RGB观点.

blocks.en: Table S29: Shared diagnostic coverage across seven models. G1 includes object-room questions, container contents, and room comparison. G2 covers object and room counting, G3 geometric measurements, and G4 relative direction. Every condition uses this same question set.
blocks.zh: 表S29:共有7个模型的诊断覆盖率。 G1包括物体室问题,容器内装物,以及房间比较. G2覆盖了物体和房间的计数,G3几何测量,以及G4相对方向. 每个条件都使用同样的问题集.

blocks.en: The 36 counting and room-comparison questions use 16 distinct scene RGB observations. These cover all task targets and include at least two background views. Remaining views are chosen by deterministic scene sampling without a fixed quota per target. The 17 container-contents questions use 40 slots, applying the same view-selection rule to all public options. The other 86 questions use 12 slots.
blocks.zh: 36个计数和房间对比问题使用了16个截然不同的场景RGB观测. 其中包括所有任务目标,至少包括两种背景观点。 其余观点是通过确定性的场景取样来选择的,没有设定每个目标的配额。 17个容器内容问题使用40个插槽,对所有公共选项适用相同的取景选择规则. 其他86个问题使用12个位.

blocks.en: We construct GT trajectory observations from scene geometry and task-target annotations, then provide annotation-free RGB views. We check that the observations cover the task targets. Frame IDs do not indicate target identity or selection roles, and the views are presented in a shuffled order. The model is told that views can repeat objects and must be matched to unique instances. Model-visible materials contain the task, public references, and scene observations. Target masks, instance counts, and correctness labels remain in private selection and scoring records.
blocks.zh: 我们从场景几何和任务目标说明中构建出GT轨迹观测,然后提供无注释的RGB视图. 我们检查观察是否涵盖了任务目标。 框架ID没有显示目标身份或选择角色,视图以被洗牌的顺序显示. 该模型被告知视图可以重复对象,必须匹配到独特的实例. 模型可见材料包含任务,公开参考,以及场景观测. 目标口罩,例数,正确性标签仍保留在私人选择和评分记录中.

blocks.en: 15.2 Spatial Sensor Inputs
blocks.zh: 15.2 空间传感器输入

blocks.en: The sensor condition keeps the generated GT trajectory RGB observations and their order identical. It adds aligned radial-depth samples, camera positions, forward directions, and camera calibration. Radial depth measures distance from the camera in meters. The camera uses a Z-up convention with equal horizontal and vertical focal lengths. These readings supply metric scale and coordinates across views.
blocks.zh: 传感器条件使生成的GT轨迹RGB观测及其顺序保持不变. 它增加了对齐的射线深度样品,相机位置,前向和相机校正. 辐射深度测量距离相机以米计. 相机采用Z-up相机,相机上具有等同的横向和纵向焦距. 这些读数提供衡量尺度,协调各种观点。

blocks.en: Sensor inputs use depth-grid images except for the 17 container-contents questions answered by the three GPT models, which receive the same depth samples as text matrices. Thus, 922 model–question evaluations use image grids and 51 use text matrices.
blocks.zh: 传感器输入使用深度网格图像,但三种GPT模型回答的17个容器内容问题除外,它们接收的深度样本与文本矩阵相同. 因此,922模型 - 问题评价使用图像网格,51使用文本矩阵.

blocks.en: 15.3 Answers and Comparisons
blocks.zh: 15.3 答复和比较

blocks.en: Each model answers once per question and input condition. The first returned model response is retained. The content rule accepts a standalone answer command or one unique command on the final nonempty line after prose. Multiple commands, nonstring arguments, and trailing text are rejected.
blocks.zh: 每个模型每次回答一个问题和输入条件. 保留了第一个返回的模型响应。 内容规则接受一个独立解答命令或一个在发作后最终非空行上的独特命令. 多个命令,非字符串参数和后缀文本被否决.

blocks.en: Every condition contains 973 model–question evaluations: seven models on the same 139 questions. Correct-answer rates use all evaluations as the denominator. Unusable answers count as incorrect. Original outcomes are reused from each model’s recorded exploration episode. GT trajectory inputs replace that exploration context, while the sensor contrast adds depth, pose, and calibration jointly to identical RGB observations. Table S28 reports per-model results and their pooled totals.
blocks.zh: 每个条件包含973个模型-问题评价:七个模型针对相同的139个问题. 正确回答率将所有评价作为分母。 无法使用的答案计为不正确 。 原始结果从每个模型的被记录的勘探插曲中被再用. GT轨迹输入取代了这种探索背景,而传感器对比则增加了深度、姿势和校正等同RGB观测。 表S28按模式报告结果及其汇总总数。

blocks.en: GT trajectory RGB gives 631/973 correct answers (64.9%), 6.5 percentage points above GT view supplementation. This comparison jointly replaces the target views and the exploration context. Adding spatial sensors to identical RGB inputs gives 755/973 (77.6%), a further gain of 12.7 percentage points. The sensor comparison supports providing physical scale and common coordinates together with target views.
blocks.zh: GT轨迹 RGB给出了631/973的正确答案(64.9%),高于GT视图补充的6.5个百分点. 这一比较共同取代了目标观点和勘探背景. 将空间感应器添加到相同的RGB输入器中,给予755/973(77.6%),再增加12.7%. 传感器比较支持提供物理尺度和共同坐标以及目标视图。

blocks.en: Together, these results show that target observations beyond the original history and joint geometric feedback improve final spatial judgments. GT trajectory RGB still leaves 342/973 incorrect or unusable answers, compared with 218/973 after adding sensors. These remaining errors suggest pairing richer inputs with more reliable cross-view instance matching and task-specific use of geometric measurements. The diagnostics evaluate one final answer on active-exploration tasks; the full benchmark separately checks whether complete episodes satisfy T.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,超越原始历史的目标观测和联合几何反馈可以改善最终空间判断。 GT轨迹RGB仍然留下了342/973不正确或无法使用的答案,相较于添加传感器后的218/973. 这些所余错误表明,将更丰富的投入与更可靠的交叉视图实例匹配和按具体任务使用几何测量结果相配。 诊断者评价一个关于活性探索任务的最后答案;完整的基准单独检查完整事件是否满足T.

blocks.en: 16 Evaluation Configuration
blocks.zh: 16 评价配置

blocks.en: Appendix 7 describes the observation and action flow within an episode. Here we collect the complete inference, input, and skill configuration for all seven models in the main 250-task evaluation. All evaluations use a temperature of 0 and top-p of 1, with reasoning effort set to the highest level supported by each model. Table S30 summarizes the shared input and interaction limits. Task-specific reference images and initial states follow the benchmark task files.
blocks.zh: 附录7描述了一集内的观察和行动流. 在这里,我们收集了250项主要任务评价中所有七个模型的全部推论,投入和技能配置. 所有评价都使用0和上p 1的温度,推理努力设定为每个模型支持的最高水平. 表S30概述了共享投入和互动限制。 任务特定参考图像和初始状态遵循基准任务文件.

blocks.en: Table S30: Shared main-evaluation observation and interaction limits. Reference images and task-defined budgets are resolved separately for each episode.
blocks.zh: 表S30:共同的主要评价观察和互动限制。 每集分别解决参考图像和任务界定的预算.

blocks.en: The evaluated humanoid uses fixed-pose body geometry approximately 0.53 m long, 0.36 m wide, and 1.32 m high. Navigation planning uses a 0.20 m clearance radius. Execution checks oriented body geometry with a 0.01 m margin and stops at collisions. Manipulation checks horizontal reach to the selected surface or nearest object boundary, using a nominal 1.5 m limit and a 0.05 m gate tolerance. Image-point commands refer to the latest delivered camera image and are mapped to the selected object or 3D surface. The platform’s high-level skills validate these geometry and access conditions before applying the requested grasp, release, or articulation transition. Outcome verification separately checks the designated object’s identity and destination, while S adds post-placement support verification.
blocks.zh: 被评价的人体用固定的pose体几何体长约0.53米,宽0.36米,高1.32米. 通航规划采用0.20米通航半径. 以0.01米相距并相撞时停止执行检查为方向的车体几何. 操纵检查横向到达选定的地表或最近的物体边界,使用名义上1.5米的限制和0.05米的门容. 图像点命令指最近交付的相机图像并被映射到所选对象或3D表面. 平台的高水平技能验证了这些几何学和进入条件,然后才应用所要求的抓取、释放或表达过渡。 结果核查单独检查指定对象的身份和目的地,而S则增加位置后支持核查.

blocks.en: The parser checks the action command and arguments before execution. Invalid outputs receive parsing feedback and produce no environment action. Eight cumulative unparsable outputs end an episode. The transport client allows at most ten attempts per call, with a 120-second request timeout and bounded backoff for transient failures. When a provider explicitly rejects an optional request parameter, the client removes that parameter before retrying. A nonempty response returns to the parser and is not regenerated; unavailable or unusable final answers count as incorrect.
blocks.zh: 解析器在执行前检查动作命令和参数. 无效的产出接收到解析反馈, 不产生环境动作 。 累计8个无法解析的产出结束一集. 运输客户端最多允许每次呼叫10次尝试,有120秒请求超时,并限定为瞬间故障后退. 当一个提供者明确拒绝一个可选的请求参数时,客户端在重试之前会删除该参数. 非空响应返回解析器, 并且不重生成; 无法或无法使用的最后答案计为不正确 。

blocks.en: The four GT settings retain the question and public references and follow the input protocols in the preceding diagnostic sections. They obtain one final response per model and question. Sensors augment identical GT trajectory RGB views with radial depth, camera pose, and calibration. Original episode outcomes are reused as the baseline.
blocks.zh: 四个GT设置保留了问题和公开引用,并遵循了前面诊断部分的输入协议. 每个模型和问题都得到一个最后答复。 传感器用光圈深度、相机姿势和校准来增强相同的GT轨迹RGB视图。 原剧集结果被再用作为基线.

blocks.en: 16.1 Example System Prompt
blocks.zh: 16.1 示例系统提示

blocks.en: The following example shows the system-prompt format for a surface-contents task. Task instructions, reference captions, and action budgets vary by task. The final paragraphs specify retrieval, intermediate-frame retention, and cumulative odometry. The accompanying code provides the prompt templates and per-round observation messages.
blocks.zh: 以下示例显示了一个表面内容任务的系统即时格式. 任务说明、参考说明和行动预算因任务而异。 最后几段具体说明了检索、中间帧保留和累积等。 相伴随的代码提供了即时模板和每轮观察信息.

blocks.en: You are the decision-making brain of a household robot in a simulated house.
blocks.zh: 你是模拟房子里一个家庭机器人的决策大脑。

blocks.en: Each round you receive three things: a photograph from the robot’s own camera, one line of text saying whether your hand is full, and a report of what the robot’s own body measured while carrying out your last action. You issue exactly one action per round. There is no description of this house, no list of what is in it, and nothing anywhere that names anything -- everything you come to know about the place you will have worked out from pictures.
blocks.zh: 每一回合你都收到三件事:一张照片来自机器人自己的相机,一行文字说明你的手是否满了,一行文字报告机器人自己在进行最后的动作时所测量的身体. 你每发一发一发 没有关于这所房子的描述,没有里面的东西的清单, 也没有任何地方能命名任何东西的, 所有你开始知道的地方,你将会从图片中找到。

blocks.en: - It is 768x432 pixels with a wide lens, taken from the robot’s eye height. Small or distant things are only a few pixels wide and are easy to mistake for something else, so treat a distant identification as a guess until you have walked closer. - Where a thing sits in the frame is not a hint about your action, it **is** your action: every skill takes a pixel coordinate read off this image. Look at the picture before every single move. - You are shown the 20 most recent photographs, not just the newest one. Use them together with the body report: the report says what the robot *did*, and the difference between consecutive frames says what that achieved. Where the report stops short -- and it says so when it does -- the pictures are all you have. - ‘holding:‘ says ‘(something)‘ or ‘(nothing)‘, and that is the only fact about the world’s state you are ever given in words. It will never say what you are carrying: a gripper measures force and finger position, not names.
blocks.zh: - 说吧 这是768x432像素,带有宽镜,取自机器人的眼高. 小事或远事只是几个像素宽而容易为别事出错,所以在走得更近之前,将远事识别当作猜想. - 说吧 当一个东西坐在框架里 并不是对你的动作的提示时, 它就是**你的动作: 每个技能都拿一个像素坐标来读取这个图像。 每次行动前看看照片 20个最新照片 不只是最新照片 与身体报告一起使用:报告说机器人*做*什么,相接框之间的区别说它取得了什么. 如果报告不及时 -- -- 它说,当报告完成时 -- -- 照片就是你的全部。 - '持有: ' 说`(某事)'或`(无)',这是你用口语表达的世界状况的唯一事实。 它永远不会说出你携带的东西: 抓取力测量力和手指位置,而不是名字。

blocks.en: You are given no text description of this house. Not the rooms it has, not the furniture in it, not the name of a single object, and no list that fills in as you explore. The one line of text you get each round is ‘holding:‘, and it says only whether your hand is full or empty -- never what is in it.
blocks.zh: 你没有这房子的文字描述 不是它拥有的房间,也不是它里面的家具, 也不是单一物体的名称, 也没有你探索时填写的列表。 每一回合你得到的一行文字是‘持有',它只说你的手是满的还是空的,从来不说里面有什么。

blocks.en: Your senses are the photograph and what the robot can feel in its own body. Your only memory is this conversation: every THOUGHT line you write is kept and shown back to you on every later round, while the older photographs are dropped. So the notes you take are the only durable record you will have -- when you see that the kitchen is through the left-hand doorway, write that down, because the picture proving it will be gone. If you pick something up and it matters later what it was, write that down too: the ‘holding:‘ line will not remind you.
blocks.zh: 你的感官是照片 以及机器人在自己的身体里能感觉到的 你唯一的记忆就是这段对话:每写出一行想法,就会被保留下来,并在以后的每一回显示给你,而更古老的照片则被放下. 所以,你所拍的笔记是唯一的持久记录—— 当你看到厨房是经过左手的门道时, 记下来,因为证明它的照片会消失。 如果你捡到一些东西,然后它又是什么重要的东西,那就写下它:`持有'的行不会提醒你。

blocks.en: Rules that matter: - You refer to things by **pointing at them in the photograph**, and there is no other way to refer to anything. Every skill below takes ‘u, v‘: ‘u‘ is the column counting from the **left** edge, ‘v‘ is the row counting from the **top** edge, both in pixels, so ‘u‘ is 0-767 and ‘v‘ is 0-431 on this 768x432 frame. So (384, 216) is the centre of the view, (384, 401) is the floor just in front of your feet, and (384, 30) is up near the ceiling. ‘open(384, 216)‘ opens whatever is at that point. - Aim for the **middle** of the thing you mean, not its edge. An edge pixel usually belongs to whatever is behind it, and you will act on that instead. - Objects and ground are **separate skills**, and choosing the wrong one fails rather than guessing: ‘go_to_object_at_pixel(u, v)‘ walks up to a *thing* and stops within reach of it, while ‘go_to_ground_at_pixel(u, v)‘ walks onto a patch of *floor* and stands there. The robot’s depth camera can work out whether the point you gave lies on the floor plane or stands above it, so when you pick the wrong skill it says which -- and then the thing to change is the skill, not the pixel. - Nothing names anything for you. What you are pointing at is entirely your own reading of the image, with no second opinion to check it against, so a coordinate that looks like a mug handle may be a spoon or a shadow. When it matters, walk closer and look again before you act. - To put something somewhere: pick(u, v) on the thing, then walk to the destination, then place(u, v) pointing at the destination -- ‘place‘ points at where it goes, the held object is implied. The ‘holding:‘ line tells you whether your hand is full but never what is in it, and a held object is also carried in front of the camera, in the lower middle of the frame. - ‘go_to_object_at_pixel(u, v)‘ only reaches what is on screen at this instant -- that is what pointing means. Something you saw two rooms ago is memory, not a target: there is no pixel you can give for it. If what you want is not in the frame, turn, look or walk until it is; that search is your job, not the skill’s. - ‘go_to_ground_at_pixel(u, v)‘ is how you cross a room. Point it at floor as far away as you can still see clearly -- through a doorway, at the far wall’s base -- and you will walk there. It needs no object in view, so it is the right tool for getting into a room you cannot see into yet. - For measured motion, positive move is forward, positive strafe is right, positive turn is left and positive look is up. Negative values reverse each direction. - You have a budget of 100 actions. Rooms are not all visible from where you stand; turning and walking to look around is expected and costs budget. - **After each action you are told what the robot’s own body measured, and nothing else.** Each line opens with the instrument it came from, and these are the ones you will see: ‘Odometry:‘ -- the wheels counting how far the base rolled and how far it turned; ‘Head encoder:‘ -- whether the camera’s pitch joint moved or hit the end of its travel; ‘Gripper:‘ -- whether anything is between the fingers; ‘Wrist force sensor:‘ -- whether the thing the hand pushed on actually moved under it; ‘Depth camera:‘ and ‘Local map:‘ -- what the range image and the floor plan made of the point you pointed at; ‘Arm:‘ -- whether a reachable arm pose exists from where the base is standing. The label tells you what kind of claim you are reading. - Those lines are measurements, not judgements, and they are complete. "The fingers closed and came back empty" is not a refusal with the reason left out -- it is everything the robot felt. Nothing will ever tell you "that is not something you can pick up", or "you cannot reach that from here", or what any object is called, because no sensor on the robot measures those things. - Placement feedback ends with "read the new photograph", and means it literally. When you put something down, the hand knows it let go and nothing on the robot knows where the object came to rest. You have to see this for yourself. - An action that achieved nothing leaves the view **exactly** as it was, so two identical photographs in a row mean your last action did nothing at all -- and the thing to change is the action, not the number of times you try it. - You are still told when your own message could not be used: a reply this harness could not parse, a call that is not on the skill list, a coordinate off the edge of the frame. Those are about what you wrote rather than about the house, and they arrive before the robot moves at all.

blocks.en: Unified memory and action decision. Recent observation images remain visible; older rounds have an indexed summary, chosen action and original execution receipt. All previous original observation/reply text is archived and retrievable. Summaries are uncertain notes, not ground truth. Choose EITHER retrieve information OR one normal action in each reply. After retrieval you see its results and make the SAME decision again. Retrieval does not spend physical action steps; at most two retrieval requests are allowed per action round, including empty or invalid requests. No more flag or separate selector is needed. If the information is sufficient, select the action directly. Avoid repeatedly retrieving the same landmarks without a concrete unresolved question. For retrieval reply: THOUGHT: <brief information gap> RETRIEVE: {"retrieve": [image_ids], "retrieve_text": [integer_rounds]} For an action reply: MEMORY: <at most 100 words of observed facts, distinctive objects/rooms, orientation, counting/de-duplication evidence and unresolved uncertainty> THOUGHT: <brief reason> ACTION: <one call from the skills above> Never output RETRIEVE and ACTION in the same reply. The current action has NOT executed; only summarize its outcome after the next execution receipt. All historical images have historical coordinates. Use ONLY the CURRENT FINAL observation for action pixels. C intermediate memory: the first decision previews ALL candidate intermediate frames from the previous action. On that first reply optionally add KEEP: [candidate_frame_ids] before other headers, whether retrieving or acting. Default KEEP is []. Keep only key views; unselected candidates are discarded from later requests and cannot be retrieved. Kept views enter recent history and the archive alongside the final observation. Keep selection is final for this round. Image IDs use R##.F and R##.I##; text IDs use integer round numbers. CONTENTS CHECK: inspect the entire named surface or container from enough views to cover it. Include only objects directly on or in that target, keep distinct instances, and exclude nearby objects on another surface. Before answer(), check this evidence once; retrieve a relevant old view only when a specific part of the target remains unresolved.

blocks.en: Self-trajectory sensor: every decision includes one cumulative top-down odometry plot through the current pose. It contains only the robot’s own x/z/yaw history, metric grid and step order; it contains no floor plan, room boundary, room label, object location or task truth. Use it to reason about where you have moved and turned. The CURRENT FINAL camera image remains the last image and is the only source for action pixel coordinates.
